hypothesis: With retrieval and reader policy fixed, selected-span presentation can improve downstream QA while making provenance and overhead tradeoffs measurable.
current_scope: Offline capture/replay and synthetic presentation mechanics only

draft_quality_protocol.primary_outcome: Paired per-query answer correctness at the same actual model-input budget
draft_quality_protocol.baseline: R0 with frozen retrieval and the same reader/input policy
draft_quality_protocol.proposed_held_out_rule: Positive paired-bootstrap lower confidence bound, with 97.5 percent intervals per comparison for the two planned comparisons; 10000 fixed-seed resamples
draft_quality_protocol.dev_rule: Same direction on DEV and two repeated reader passes; report observed agreement, do not claim deterministic model generation
draft_quality_protocol.selection_rule: Freeze configuration and select any candidate on DEV before held-out outcomes; no question-specific or post-outcome renderer tuning
draft_quality_protocol.abstention_rule: Report separate confusion counts and denominators after labels are joined by the evaluator; do not infer success from empty retrieval
draft_quality_protocol.provenance_rule: Report available, complete and exact-span provenance counts for every arm; an R2 promotion must not reduce provenance completeness below R1 at the registered budget
draft_quality_protocol.failure_rule: Preserve every failed attempt, report coverage and infrastructure failures separately, and do not drop missing queries or score provider failures as wrong answers
draft_quality_protocol.decision_rule: Any unmeasured outcome, failed isolation invariant, insufficient sample, or inconclusive benefit remains ITERATE; synthetic retention alone cannot justify KEEP

dependency_gates.103: Still requires accepted #28/#74/#96/#100; this draft is only a potential input boundary
dependency_gates.104: Still requires accepted #74/#100/#103 and independently reviewed judge calibration
dependency_gates.105: Still requires accepted #96/#100/#103/#104 and a separate preregistered full-500 run

storage_rule: Keep captures, questions, source content, raw inputs, dataset labels and all provider outputs outside Git; only compact non-content evidence may be versioned
non_claims: No measured downstream QA, abstention, control-flow or reader-latency benefit
No official LongMemEval result or fair external-system comparison
No new temporal validity, source authority, conflict arbitration or evidence-sufficiency behavior
No dependency closure or change to canonical Benchmark Ledger profiles
